hooks.name: Accessibility check on page or component save
hooks.description: When a page or component is saved, run the axe accessibility tests so violations are caught early. Report only; never edits files, so it cannot re-trigger itself.

action.prompt: A page or component under app/ or components/ was just saved. Run `npx vitest run app/__tests__/pages.axe.test.tsx` once. Report any serious or critical axe violations with the rule id and the element, then stop. Do NOT edit, create, or save any files in response to this hook: editing a .tsx file would re-trigger this hook and loop. If a fix is needed, describe it and let the user ask for it. Remember: automated checks do not prove full WCAG conformance.
